# generator-shortcuts

> For this generator, name the strongest plausible shortcut or rival rule that fits the canonical demonstrations. Give an exact input on which it disagrees with the intended rule, how you checked the output, and whether your proposed generator emits such cases.

## Strongest plausible rival

The strongest remaining rival is a **color-blind exact-horizontal-domino rule**:
recolor every 4-connected component whose normalized shape is exactly 1×2 horizontal
cyan (8), regardless of the component's input color.

It fits all canonical demonstrations because every canonical foreground object is gray
(5). It also fits every ordinary grid emitted by the repaired generator because that
supported domain contains only colors 0 and 5. The repaired generator's two declared
structural rivals are weaker and are refuted in every ordinary scene by the mandatory
vertical domino and horizontal-adjacency non-domino.

## Exact disagreement input

Input: 7 rows × 9 columns.

```text
000000000
055000000
000000000
000000000
000001100
000000000
000000000
```

The intended gray-specific rule recolors only the gray horizontal domino:

```text
000000000
088000000
000000000
000000000
000001100
000000000
000000000
```

The color-blind rival also recolors the blue (1) horizontal domino:

```text
000000000
088000000
000000000
000000000
000008800
000000000
000000000
```

## How it was checked

I ran the unchanged canonical Racket authority with:

```text
python3 review.py run python3 -m arcpuzzles apply e46c2557ad08 \
  --input ../checks/question/e46c2557ad08/input.json \
  --out ../checks/question/e46c2557ad08/racket.json
```

The executed rule hash was `bba257d19e2b`, matching the catalog and the repaired
`RULE_HASH`. The Racket output hash is
`0ffc70aadbbd13e82a0be5e557386f7c9a088b86c51505590b0807e363cbb8c5`;
the rival output differs. Full grids, hashes, self-check findings and commands are bound
together in `checks/question/e46c2557ad08/evidence.json`.

## Does the repaired generator emit such cases?

No. The exact witness is outside the documented generator domain: it is 7×9 instead of
8..14 × 9..16, contains blue foreground, and lacks the mandatory vertical and near-miss
distractors. More importantly, the generator intentionally emits only black (0) and gray
(5), so it cannot produce any colored-domino counterexample to this extension. This is a
known domain limitation, not a claim that the rival has been ruled out globally.
